docs.title: Ferran López Sierra — Engineering Portfolio
docs.text: This portfolio presents a mechanical engineering profile with a strong computational component. The focus is on engineering software, CAD/CAE workflows, simulation, automation, and technical documentation developed with practical open-source tools.

docs.title: Profile direction
docs.text: The portfolio is structured as a technical record of ongoing work, academic foundations, and learning-oriented engineering projects. It is intended to show how mechanical engineering methods can be combined with programming, reproducible workflows, and engineering analysis tools without overstating project maturity.

docs.title: Current status
docs.text:
• The website is being built as a MkDocs Material portfolio published through GitHub Pages.
  • Several project pages are intentionally marked as planned, academic, or in learning phase while documentation is expanded.
  • The main short-term goal is to document engineering workflows, numerical studies, and open-source toolchains in a clear and reproducible way.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
I am a mechanical engineer developing a technical profile that combines engineering fundamentals with computational tools, simulation workflows, automation, and engineering software.

My current direction sits between mechanical engineering practice and software-oriented problem solving. That includes numerical methods, CAD/CAE preparation, geometry handling, scripting, and reproducible technical documentation.

This portfolio is intentionally conservative in how projects are described. Some pages document academic work, some are in development, and others are structured as learning projects that support a broader computational engineering workflow.

docs.title: Main interests
docs.text:
• Engineering software and technical automation
  • CAD/CAE workflows built on open-source tools
  • Numerical simulation and pre/post-processing
  • Geometry, coordinate systems, and engineering computation
  • Technical writing with Markdown, LaTeX, Git, and GitHub Pages
